chunks: And Safwan narrated from al-'Ala' from Ibn Abi Ya'fur and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Humran from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the two rak'ahs of Fajr, when should I pray them? He said: 'Before Fajr, with it, and after it.'

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: The two sunnah rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: When is the best time to pray the two sunnah rak'ahs of Fajr?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the jurisprudential flexibility (tawassu') regarding the Fajr sunnah rak'ahs, a key topic in Shia fiqh regarding the distinction between *qabliyyah* (before) and *ba'diyyah* (after) prayers. The Imam’s tripartite answer—before, with, and after—reflects the practical allowance for combining these voluntary prayers with the obligatory Fajr prayer, particularly for those traveling or seeking to consolidate worship. This flexibility underscores the Shia emphasis on ease in ritual practice while maintaining the sanctity of the prescribed times.
